note: 着装仪容编号库。工牌与门禁场景优先选择无 logo、低反光的款式，避免批次内不一致。

wear.desc_zh: 纯黑或深灰圆领，无任何印花与 logo，面料哑光不反光
wear.desc_en: Plain black or charcoal crew neck, zero print or logo, matte non-reflective fabric
wear.prompt_zh: 深色哑光圆领上衣，无图案无标识，领口平整不起翘
wear.prompt_en: dark matte crew-neck top, no pattern no logo, flat collar with no curl

wear.desc_zh: 立领或半高领，弱化领带感，保留一点正式度
wear.desc_en: Stand or mock neck, lowers the tie factor while keeping formality
wear.prompt_zh: 深色半高领上衣，线条干净，无配饰无 logo
wear.prompt_en: dark mock-neck top with clean lines, no accessories no logo

wear.desc_zh: 白或浅蓝衬衫，领口挺括第一颗扣可选系
wear.desc_en: White or pale blue shirt with a crisp collar
wear.prompt_zh: 浅色挺括衬衫，领型清晰不软塌，衣面无杂褶
wear.prompt_en: light crisp shirt with a clearly defined collar, fabric free of random wrinkles

wear.desc_zh: 深蓝或深灰西装，肩线合体，素色内搭
wear.desc_en: Navy or charcoal suit with correct shoulders and a plain inner layer
wear.prompt_zh: 合体深色西装，肩线贴合不松不紧，内搭素色，整体低装饰
wear.prompt_en: well-fitted dark suit with shoulders that neither gap nor pull, plain inner layer, overall low ornamentation

wear.desc_zh: 中薄针织，降低压迫感，适合教育与职能岗
wear.desc_en: Mid-weight knit that softens authority, fits education and HR
wear.prompt_zh: 素色针织开衫，织纹细腻可见，肩袖自然不夸张
wear.prompt_en: solid knit cardigan with fine visible texture, natural shoulder and sleeve lines

wear.desc_zh: 纯色 Polo，领子立得住，休闲与规范之间
wear.desc_en: Solid polo with a collar that holds shape, between casual and standard
wear.prompt_zh: 纯色 Polo 衫，领口平整有支撑，无刺绣标识
wear.prompt_en: solid polo shirt with a flat supported collar, no embroidered marks

wear.desc_zh: 细针织高领，去领带感并保留权威
wear.desc_en: Fine-knit turtleneck that keeps authority without a tie
wear.prompt_zh: 细针织高领，贴合颈部不堆褶，色调沉稳单一
wear.prompt_en: fine-knit turtleneck sitting close without bunching, in a single restrained tone

wear.desc_zh: 平整白大褂，内搭浅色，胸前不挂杂物
wear.desc_en: Crisp white coat over a light layer, nothing clipped on the chest
wear.prompt_zh: 干净平整的白大褂，领口翻开对称，内搭浅色，不佩戴听诊器等杂物
wear.prompt_en: clean pressed white coat with symmetrical open lapels over a light inner layer, no stethoscope or clutter

wear.desc_zh: 企业统一工服，批量场景必须锁定同一款式与同一色号
wear.desc_en: Company uniform; in batch work the style and color code must be locked
wear.prompt_zh: 统一工服，款式与色号一致，衣牌位置规范，无个性化改造
wear.prompt_en: standardized uniform with consistent style and color code, name badge placed to spec, no personal alteration

wear.desc_zh: 含反光条工装或安全帽，适用于产线与仓储门禁照
wear.desc_en: Reflective workwear or hard hat for plant and warehouse badge photos
wear.prompt_zh: 符合安全规范的工装，反光条清晰，帽带系好，面部无遮挡
wear.prompt_en: safety-compliant workwear with clear reflective strips, chin strap fastened, face fully unobstructed

wear.desc_zh: 浅色系护理服，头发束起，仪容规范
wear.desc_en: Light nursing uniform or scrubs with hair tied back
wear.prompt_zh: 整洁浅色护理服，领口对称，头发放顺束起，不佩戴悬垂耳饰
wear.prompt_en: tidy light nursing uniform with symmetrical collar, hair tied back, no dangling earrings

wear.desc_zh: 有面料质感的纯色基础款，靠剪裁而非logo体现品位
wear.desc_en: Solid basics where cut and fabric texture carry taste instead of logos
wear.prompt_zh: 剪裁利落的纯色基础款，面料质感在光下可辨，无标识无多余装饰
wear.prompt_en: clean-cut solid basics whose fabric texture reads under light, no marks and no surplus detail
